note: Applied proposed repairs including literal Cai Mo. Author cannot approve editorial-decisions.

proposals.before: Restore the Minister of Works' field clerks—one per province—to promote farming and sericulture and judge magistrates' performance, as in former times.
proposals.after: Restore the Minister of Education's field clerks—one per province—to promote farming and sericulture and judge magistrates' performance, as in former times.
proposals.reason: 司徒 is the Minister of Education, not the Minister of Works (司空).

proposals.before: He recommended Xun Mo for Xuzhou.
proposals.after: He recommended Cai Mo for Xuzhou.
proposals.reason: 太常臣謨 is Cai Mo (蔡謨), named in s0331; Xun Mo is a mistranslation

proposals.before: Minister Xun Mo is level, simple, upright, and true—the plain expectation returns to him—I say he may serve as Area Commander and Inspector of Xuzhou.
proposals.after: Minister Cai Mo is level, simple, upright, and true—the plain expectation returns to him—I say he may serve as Area Commander and Inspector of Xuzhou.
proposals.reason: 太常臣謨 is Cai Mo (蔡謨), named in s0331; Xun Mo is a mistranslation in the literal field as well.
